div.div: Append-only audit: no runtime role holds UPDATE, DELETE, or TRUNCATE on audit_events (verified against PostgreSQL). Audit rows are written in the same transaction as the action they record, so an action and its audit commit together; they are not batched separately (deliberate, D-025).
